statement: Let Y be the complex blow-up of CP1 ×CP1 at {0, ∞}×{0, ∞}. There is a Kähler form ωY for which the lifted diagonal circle action is Hamiltonian. Its half-turn gY fixes exactly the four exceptional curves E1, . . . , E4, each isomorphic to CP1 . Along each curve its derivative is the identity tangentially and minus the identity on the symplectic normal bundle. The surface is simply connected, with Hi(Y ; Z) ∼ =        Z, i = 0, 4, Z6, i = 2, 0, otherwise, ⟨c1(TY ), [Ej]⟩ = 1.
